summary: Bilibili filed a Form 6-K attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for September 2026, mapping to a routine US current report on Form 8-K. The filing discloses movements in authorized share capital and issued shares: Class Z shares rose by 1,628,981 to 340,434,736, while Class Y weighted-voting shares were unchanged at 79,700,010. Authorized capital remains USD 1,000,000 across classes at USD 0.0001 par. The issuer confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or strategic transaction is stated; this is an ordinary equity-issuer housekeeping disclosure, not a special situation.
